sources: The $1.5B acquisition adds AI-driven customer data capabilities to Diginex's sustainability and compliance platform — transforming it from a point solution into an integrated end-to-end platform.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: soft violet. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: two paper tiles; a strip of tape.
Opens on the screen, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the screen splits into two paper tiles; tape binds them into one panel.
Ends holding on the bound panel.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "END-TO-END".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "END-TO-END". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Diginex moves from a point solution to an integrated platform.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.
expandedPrompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a 2D motion design style, photographed as a flat lay under soft, neutral room light. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, where a soft violet block-color paper ground fills the frame. In the upper left, a cream paper chip with a rough torn edge displays the text "$1.5B" in bold black sans-serif. Below it, a stack of black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of blank coins and a blank computer screen are arranged, all featuring rough white torn-paper edges and casting small, soft shadows from a light source in the upper left. Every surface is matte printed paper with visible texture and no glow. Immediately on the first frame, the camera remains in a Static Shot as the "$1.5B" chip and the existing coins and screen slide rapidly off-frame toward the top edge. Simultaneously, a new cream paper chip enters from the top and lands with a slight overshoot in the upper third of the frame; it is printed with the extra-bold black sans-serif text "END-TO-END", which remains perfectly stable and legible. In the lower two-thirds of the frame, two rectangular black-and-white halftone photographic paper tiles of blank screens slide in from opposite sides, meeting in the center. As they align, a small strip of matte cream paper tape quickly snaps across the seam, binding the two tiles into a single integrated panel. The composition holds steady for the remainder of the video, showcasing the bound panel and the "END-TO-END" headline against the unbroken soft violet background. A narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says <d>[English] Diginex moves from a point solution to an integrated platform.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio features the tactile, crisp sound of paper sliding across a flat surface, followed by two distinct, rhythmic paper-slap sounds as the tiles land. A short, adhesive "tack" sound of tape being pressed onto paper synchronizes with the appearance of the tape strip.
